observations.the_eyes_of_glouphrie: Use Construction at the start and base Magic for glue. Solve the variable disc lock, defeat six creatures in any order and return to Narnode. Singing the seed into a saw is a separate diary task.
observations.his_faithful_servants: The identity of the tunnel brother varies. Clear the other five mounds, then use the tunnel to reach and defeat the last brother in the same run. Loot the icon after six kills. The old man awards Prayer XP and the map; reading it separately unlocks the minimap.
observations.museum_camp: After Fossil Island access, build six facilities independently for 3,650 total Construction XP. Peter awards five unidentified small fossils in a separate visit.
observations.kudos_thresholds: The tracker IDs end in 50, 100 and 150. The modeled award thresholds are 51, 101 and 151. Grant each award once and preserve kudos. This is separate from Bone Voyage's 100-kudos prerequisite.
observations.minas_reports: Rune Mysteries, Observatory Quest, Demon Slayer and The Grand Tree each give five kudos in separate upstairs dialogue. The quiz, those reports and the existing What Lies Below report total 53 kudos.
